selection: The same standards owner-document, schema and template selection used by T-005; no prior representations or grades.

codex.interpretation: The selected Codex RC9 owner-source bytes and Git blobs are identical to the older RC5 corpus. A fresh rebuild measures generation variability and changed subject coordinates, not a source-content improvement. RC9 package labels and interpretation metadata are excluded from semantic input.

claude.interpretation: Claude RC9 changes ASSURANCE and FOUNDATIONS: a failing scenario establishes observed-versus-expected disagreement; actual behaviour disagrees only where its observation binding is supported, and the observation-sufficiency consumers carry that condition. Other changed standards members are excluded frames.

limits: Exact selected-source custody and byte delta only; no semantic assessment, performance, acceptance or release claim.
